payload.core_mechanism_summary: Backward 1D DP: l[i] = cost at i + l[i+k] (if i+k < n). Then evaluate removal cost by adding i*y to index i+p-1 and taking min.
payload.rationale: The DP array is one-dimensional; state is index i. It aggregates costs for positions i, i+k, i+2k,... from right to left. This is a classic 1D DP with stepwise dependency, not 2D state.
